title: Omron D2MQ subminiature basic switch datasheet
note: Supplied by the user as an upload (en-d2mq.pdf) on November 26, 2026 and stored unchanged; Omron's site cannot be reached from the review environment, so the URL is given for reference only. Hinge-lever models: operating force 0.39 N max, pretravel 2.1 mm max, overtravel 0.3 mm min, free position 8.7 mm max and operating position 7.1 +/-0.5 mm, both measured from the mounting-hole centre line, which is 1.6 mm above the case bottom. Straight terminals: three at 2.5 mm pitch, 0.8 x 0.6 mm, 3.4 mm long. 0.5 A models have silver contacts and a 5 V 50 mA minimum load; -105 models have gold contacts and a 5 V 5 mA minimum load.
first_page_excerpt: D2MQ Subminiature Basic Switch. Ultra Slim Snap-action Switch with 2.7 mm in depth.
